title: netbox-pki plugin
description: Native NetBox SoT for PKI — certificate authorities, ACME accounts, and issued certificates (subject/SANs, key algorithm, validity window, renewal policy, status). Composes netbox-services (PkiCertificate FKs ServiceInstance). Standalone from netbox_ssl (a passive cert store); models are Pki-prefixed (PkiCertificateAuthority/PkiCertificate) to avoid a tags reverse-accessor clash with netbox_ssl (E304) — no dependency, no duplication. Baseline scaffold + full spec is committed and py_compile-clean; the items below are the deep work owed against a live NetBox.

phases.title: Live-NetBox verification
phases.exit_criteria: makemigrations --check --dry-run reports no changes and the full test suite is green on the pinned NetBox 4.6.

items.description: Run `python manage.py makemigrations netbox_pki --check --dry-run` on an ephemeral NetBox 4.6; confirm the hand-authored 0001_initial matches the models (FK target netbox_services.serviceinstance serializes, ArrayField(sans) surface matches, dependencies resolve).

`python /opt/netbox/app/netbox/manage.py test netbox_pki --keepdb -v2` green: models (clean() ACME-account gates, uniqueness, is_expiring property, PROTECT, SET_NULL), api (CRUD mixins), filtersets (incl. SAN search).

Confirm `netbox_services.api.serializers.ServiceInstanceSerializer` import path resolves at runtime under the deployed netbox-services wheel; adjust the nested serializer import if the sibling renames it.

phases.title: Deploy + backfill
phases.exit_criteria: Plugin is installed as a wheel on prod + dev NetBox, migrated, granted, and the estate's real CAs/accounts/certificates are represented natively.

items.description: Build + `uv pip install --no-deps --reinstall` the wheel into the NetBox venv (prod pct 74234, dev pct 92254), migrate netbox_pki, restart once, and scope an ObjectPermission grant so the new models are not 403 (the netbox-system-services deploy pattern).

Populate PkiCertificateAuthority + ACMEAccount + PkiCertificate from the estate's real certificate authorities (Let's Encrypt / internal step-ca), the registered ACME accounts, and the currently-issued certificates (common_name, sans, validity window, status); credential_ref/*_ref pointing at the real OpenBao paths (never secret values).

phases.title: Seeder + consumer wiring
phases.exit_criteria: An idempotent seeder loads PKI intent into NetBox and the issuance provider + TLS consumers read it as SoT.

items.description: Idempotent upsert seeder (the netbox-seeder pattern) for PkiCertificateAuthority/ACMEAccount/PkiCertificate; every *_ref pointing at OpenBao paths (never secret values).

Wire the in-house ACME/issuance provider to read the REST contract for obtain/renew (account key from account_key_ref, key/fullchain written to key_ref/cert_ref in OpenBao, not_before/not_after/status stamped back), and wire web-server vhosts + mail relays to reference PkiCertificate.cert_ref for TLS termination.

Evaluate an OPTIONAL, standalone-safe bridge between netbox-pki (issuance SoT) and netbox_ssl (passive cert store) — e.g. materializing an issued PkiCertificate as a stored cert — as an optional dependency, never a hard cross-plugin coupling. Deferred / out of baseline scope.
